invariants.name: I01_state_isolation
invariants.description: Causal read-dependency invariance across commits: committed state version must match observed version in dependency vector.
invariants.formal_definition: \A a \in Agents : txn_state[a] = "committing" => (\A e \in ReadSet(a) : entity_versions[e] = leases[a].v_s[e])

invariants.name: I02_governance_freshness
invariants.description: Monotonic policy and consent epoch stability during commit transaction execution.
invariants.formal_definition: \A a \in Agents : txn_state[a] = "committing" => (leases[a].c_s = consent_epochs[leases[a].domain] /\ leases[a].p_s = policy_epochs[leases[a].domain])
invariants.enforcement_point: commit_kernel.py: Phase 3 Governance Revalidation under locks

invariants.name: I03_phantom_free
invariants.description: Strict fail-closed abort on concurrent epoch drift or append-only ledger phantom insertions.
invariants.formal_definition: \A a \in Agents : (txn_state[a] = "committing" /\ (leases[a].c_s /= consent_epochs[leases[a].domain] \/ leases[a].p_s /= policy_epochs[leases[a].domain])) => txn_state'[a] = "aborted"

invariants.name: I04_deadlock_free
invariants.description: Acyclic wait-for graph under strict total 7-class lock hierarchy acquisition.

invariants.name: I05_idempotency_atomicity
invariants.description: Single execution per (tenant_id, operation_kind, idempotency_key); identical duplicate requests return cached result without re-executing mutations.
invariants.formal_definition: \A t1, t2 \in applied_transitions : (t1.tenant_id = t2.tenant_id /\ t1.op_kind = t2.op_kind /\ t1.idem_key = t2.idem_key) => t1.id = t2.id

invariants.name: I06_cas_monotonicity
invariants.description: Strict single-step CAS partition version increment (successor_version = predecessor_version + 1).

invariants.name: I07_evidence_closure
invariants.description: Asserted evidence IDs in proposal must be a strict subset of evidence disclosed in the bound snapshot.

invariants.name: I08_binding_immutability
invariants.description: Inference context binding records are immutable and append-only; ORM/DB reject updates and deletes.
invariants.formal_definition: \A b \in inference_bindings : b' = b /\ ~(\E b \in inference_bindings : b \notin inference_bindings')

invariants.name: I09_lineage_preservation
invariants.description: Reviewed proposals retain the root model proposal id and root inference context binding.
invariants.formal_definition: \A p \in proposals : p.origin = "human_review" => (p.root_proposal_id /= null /\ p.inference_binding_id = Root(p).inference_binding_id)

invariants.name: I10_dependency_completeness
invariants.description: Proposal dependency vector must cover the schema-derived minimum dependency vector for the operation kind.

invariants.name: I11_no_weak_route_downgrade
invariants.description: Proposals with model origin or model lineage ancestry are forbidden from using base_version_only commit route.

invariants.name: I12_exact_inference_disclosure_continuity
invariants.description: A persistent mutation proposal is admitted only when its inference binding points to the exact snapshot and matching projection digest supplied at inference time.
invariants.formal_definition: \A p \in proposals, c \in commits : Admitted(p, c) => (\E b \in inference_bindings, s \in snapshots : p.inference_binding_id = b.id /\ b.snapshot_id = s.id /\ b.projection_digest = s.projection_digest /\ b.manifest_digest = s.manifest_digest /\ b.consumed_thss = TRUE /\ b.status = "COMPLETED")

invariants.name: I13_non_downgradable_human_lineage
invariants.description: Human modifications to a model proposal cannot alter or strip the root inference binding to bypass GRWC admission checks.
invariants.formal_definition: \A p \in proposals : (p.origin = "human_review" /\ Root(p).origin = "model") => (p.inference_binding_id = Root(p).inference_binding_id /\ p.context_binding_mode = "snapshot_bound" /\ p.source_snapshot_id = Root(p).source_snapshot_id)

invariants.name: I14_undisclosed_evidence_rejection
invariants.description: Globally valid clinical evidence present in the database but omitted from the model-visible disclosure snapshot cannot satisfy disclosure-specific evidence checks.
invariants.formal_definition: \A p \in proposals, e \in p.asserted_evidence_ids : (e \in GlobalEvidence(p.profile_id) /\ e \notin DisclosedEvidence(p.inference_binding_id)) => ~Admitted(p)

invariants.name: I15_clean_path_reachability
invariants.description: Under un-conflicted state, valid governance, and intact lineage continuity, a clean proposal transition is guaranteed to commit successfully without false rejections.
invariants.formal_definition: \A p \in proposals : (ValidLineage(p) /\ ContinuousDisclosure(p) /\ StateCurrent(p) /\ GovCurrent(p) /\ DepsComplete(p) /\ ~ConcurrentConflict(p)) => <>Committed(p)
